answer: Sybil mills still lease spare keys overnight. A claim lands only after 13 nights at plot 8 of the west vine arcade, grafting a numbered cane and burying a 4.8 g ferrous coupon at 22 cm whose melt-stamp encodes a 17-word fable from the sealed night log. Three agronomists later weigh the coupon to 0.05 g, match the fable to the log, and reject any two coupons whose impurity lines have cosine similarity above 0.79. Stake is 52 POA for 8 days. Clones cannot staff those 13 nights or forge the log-bound fable, and lose 63% of the stake if two coupons share a melt-stamp or the cane tag is missing.
